title: Retain the G20 carry producer in 24 bits (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof and exact finite construction certificate, produced by Nick Petalas. Compress Ali Romman's PR6503 carry producer's retained logical state while preserving its canonical-input validator, five-bit packet and `L+1` abstract table queries on a valid `L`-row input.

```diff
- 26 separately budgeted between-row bits
+ 24 bits using delayed first-row evaluation and a joint code
```

A quotient component with `m` states uses `4096*m+257` codes. At the source maximum `m=2406`, this is 9,855,233 codes. Twenty-four bits are sharp for the declared full product representation, not for reachable joint states or every implementation. The first verified storage improvement is shipped without extending the research scope.

Only `research/g20-carry-state-codec/` is added. The source quotient tables and carry identity are credited inputs, not audit deliverables. Their exact proof, descriptors and binary table are retained unchanged, so no pending predecessor Git object is required for replay. No new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

- Enumerate all 9,854,976 mature codes and all 256 first-row codes; prove the all-width encoding and state simulation in `PROOF.md`.
- Check all 131,072 first-two-row pairs on an actual largest-model column and 33,280 mature transitions across all 23 source models.
- Run 3,646 new-producer streams across all 729 retained source columns, totaling 36,902 rows. Every decoded prefix agrees with the unpacked floor recurrence, every final packet agrees with modular arithmetic, and every valid stream uses exactly `L+1` table queries. The longest stream has 4,097 rows.
- Seventeen invalid-domain/stream controls and two faulty-encoding collision controls pass. The verifier generates a JSON receipt bound to the package and live source input.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized commands pass locally on macOS arm64 / CPython 3.12.15, each in approximately seven seconds. Registered metadata/source validation, AST compilation, committed bytes and declared source ancestry pass. The official 12-file export passes declared-input integrity checks and read-only normal/optimized execution with identical receipts.

From the repository root, reproduce with the exact local interpreter path, or substitute another CPython 3.12 interpreter:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/g20-carry-state-codec/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/g20-carry-state-codec/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-carry-state-codec
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/g20-carry-state-codec --check-source-history
```

Expected markers are `PASS_G20_CARRY_STATE_CODEC`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The publication preflight passes at `50c4dd0426793126ea64ff4baba9a4982d9e870c`. Source PR6503 reachability, refinement and minimality censuses were not replayed.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The 24-bit count covers logical state retained between rows. Immutable coefficients/tables/descriptors, the current input row, transient arithmetic and decoding scratch, and output storage are additional. Python object memory is not this logical count. The convenience wrapper has a 65,536-row limit; the written proof and step interface cover arbitrary finite streams.

No physical tape or Boolean-circuit tariff, head return, scratch cleanup, arbitrary dirty restoration, reversible-history improvement, native realization, complete caller substitution or runtime saving is established. Precision, stock, compiler, the complete signed invoice and all five selected framework assumptions remain. No selected cold replay, predecessor scientific suite, Lean, Docker, independent human acceptance or formal proof-kernel review is claimed.

## Open next questions

1. Lower one largest-model step to an actual tape or Boolean circuit, paying for code conversion, lookup, cleanup and return. Physical implementation is the blocker to interpreting the logical storage saving as a complete backend saving.
2. Determine whether a named column's reachable joint states admit fewer than 24 bits, retaining packet and validity semantics. Coordinate with the separate initialized inverse-history claim before extending that work. The current full-product-domain lower bound does not answer this question.

## Related open work

- PR6503 supplies the 26-bit compact quotient producer and immutable tables; this changes its retained-state representation to 24 bits without redoing quotient minimization.
- PR6474 supplies the one-pass interleaved carry identity and packet interface; this retains those semantics and the source low-input checks.
- PR6531 supplies reversible restoration with a 12-bit unrestricted per-row history bound; this does not change history or make a competing history claim.
- PR6467 shortens the separate frame506 matcher factorization and its conditional ROW schedule. Its factor counts concern a different object; this result makes no matcher-factor claim.

Live open-body searches and the handoff thread were refreshed before publication. The contemporaneous initialized joint-history claim from PR6531 studies inverse fibers, not this forward representation. Arbitrary unpublished work and historical diffs remain overlap limits.

## Credit

Ali Romman supplies PR6503, PR6474 and PR5820. ToikY, Nick Petalas, Tekalign, JoyboyBrian, Kyu and the retained G20/native/ROW lineage retain their source credit. Mixed-radix encoding and delayed evaluation are classical. The new result is this concrete representation, its simulation proof and executable. New work is Apache-2.0. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19370123).

Hosted execution will certify the registered finite checks, not independent mathematical acceptance of the written proof.
